title: Apartment MEP – First Fix (pre-close)
activity: Pipework, drainage, ductwork and testing before close-up
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Pipework supported within the typical centres (copper 15 mm 1.2 m, 22–28 mm 1.8 m), no sagging or loose runs?

guide.title: Pipe support centres – typical max
guide.note: Typical industry values – the manufacturer's / PBS drawing figure governs. Anything sagging fails regardless.
guide.src: BS EN 806 / BS 8000-15 typical tables; CLM tested details (400 mm)

questions.q: Pipework pressure tested (7 bar) and test sheet signed before boxing in?
questions.source: BAF / Borough ITP – pipework pressure test

questions.q: Waste pipework at a fall of about 18 mm per 1 m, and air tested before boxing in?
Is pipe insulation complete and neat, with no gaps?
Ask the fitter: When was this tested, and how are open ends protected? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Inlet and exhaust ducts fully insulated, fire sleeves fitted where they pass through walls?
Sprinkler pipework pressure tested (15 bar) before boxing in?
Are isolation valves accessible after close-up?

notOk.t: Open-ended pipes and ducts not capped (dust ingress)
Threaded rod not cut to length (6–8 threads for end caps), no end caps
Condense pipe falling the wrong way
Flexible duct over 300 mm or not connected
FCU too close to the board line (no room for final layer)
Pipe clips loose / extra support needed at changes of direction
Fire collar missing on duct penetrations
